description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BecomingAParent"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LeaveNotification" name="Leave notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyInformationRequest" name="Company information request"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_Parent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Leave notification"
                      messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompany" name="Leave notification"
                      messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information"
                      messageRef="Message_CompanyInformationRequest"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Parent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PlanLeave" name="Plan maternity leave"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchLeaveModels" name="Fetch leave models (duration, split between parents)"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectLeaveModel" name="Select leave model"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectRelevantInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify Company" messageRef="Message_LeaveNotification"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies" messageRef="Message_CompanyInformationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LeavePeriodEnded" name="Leave period ended"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend leave?" default="Flow_NoExtension"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LeaveCompleted" name="Leave completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToFetch" sourceRef="Start_PlanLeave" targetRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FetchToSelect" sourceRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels" targetRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToCollect" sourceRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel" targetRef="Task_CollectRelevantInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToNotifySS" sourceRef="Task_CollectRelevantInformation" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySSToNotifyCompany" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyCompanyToGather" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherToLeaveEnded" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveEndedToDecision" sourceRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnded" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionRequested" name="Extension requested" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${extensionRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtension" name="No extension" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="End_LeaveCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
